modules.name: StudentArea
modules.notes: High-level group for student-facing features. Pages: dashboard, labs, attendance, activities, settings. API: labs, attendance, attestation, profile, activities. Components: StatusHero, QuickStats, DeadlinesList, LabContentTabs, LessonSheet. Functions: progress overview, lab study/submit, attendance stats (calendar/history), activity points (bonuses/penalties), attestation calculation. AGENT RULE: Only modify these when user requests student-related tasks. Do not touch AdminArea without explicit request.

modules.name: AdminArea
modules.notes: High-level group for admin/teacher-facing features. Pages: admin, groups, labs, journal, schedule, audit, reports. API: admin_labs, admin_journal, admin_reports, groups/students, admin_audit. Components: AdminSidebar, JournalTable, ScheduleGrid, ActivityManagementSection. Functions: group/lab management, journal control, report management (PIN-protected links), audit/security. AGENT RULE: Stay away from this area if the task is about students. Do not touch StudentArea without explicit request.

modules.name: backend/services/backup
modules.notes: Core backup logic. Includes backup_service.py (pg_dump, encryption, upload), restore_service.py (pg_restore, verify), encryption.py (AES-256-GCM), and notification.py (Telegram/VK).

modules.name: backend/api/backup
modules.notes: Admin backup API. Endpoints for CRUD, restore, verify, and settings. Prefix: /admin/backups/.

modules.name: frontend/app/admin/settings/backups
modules.notes: UI for backup management. Components: BackupTab (container), BackupListCard (list/actions), BackupSettingsCard (auto-backup config). Calls BackupAPI.

modules.name: PublicReportsArea
modules.notes: Publicly accessible reports for students, parents, and curators. Files: /report/[code], ReportStudentTable.tsx, public_reports.py, report_builder.py. Features: anonymity, granularity, PIN protection, Rate Limiting, Honeypot codes. Parents/curators access via link (no accounts).
